title: Anthropic inks $10B computing deal with Nvidia-backed Volta Infra
excerpt: Anthropic has signed a $10 billion, six-year deal for computing capacity with Volta Infra Holdings, a cloud infrastructure startup backed by Nvidia Corp (NAS...
content_html:
Proactive

Tue, August 4, 2026 at 11:58 AM EDT 1 min read

Anthropic has signed a $10 billion, six-year deal for computing capacity with Volta Infra Holdings, a cloud infrastructure startup backed by Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD), according to media reports citing people familiar with the matter, as the Claude maker moves to secure additional computing resources amid growing demand for its AI products.

Volta announced earlier Tuesday that it had secured a six-year, $10 billion agreement with an unnamed artificial intelligence company. The deal will be delivered in partnership with Bitdeer Technologies Group, a bitcoin miner that operates data centers, using a site in Norway.

The managed data center is expected to feature Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin AI chips, according to details of the agreement. Volta was recently valued at $2.4 billion following a $300 million funding round.

Volta CEO Ricard Boada declined to identify the customer. Representatives for Anthropic and Bitdeer declined to comment.

The agreement adds to Anthropic's efforts to expand its computing capacity as businesses and consumers increasingly use its Claude chatbot and other AI tools, particularly for coding and related tasks.

Anthropic has also entered computing agreements with SpaceX, Advanced Micro Devices and Akamai Technologies, while the company is reportedly in discussions to lease computing capacity from data centers operated by Meta Platforms.

据媒体援引知情人士的消息称，Anthropic 已与 Nvidia 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA，XETRA：NVD）支持的云基础设施初创公司 Volta Infra Holdings 签署了一项价值 100 亿美元、为期六年的计算能力协议，随着对其人工智能产品的需求不断增长，这家 Claude 制造商正在采取措施确保额外的计算资源。

Volta 周二早些时候宣布，它已与一家未具名的人工智能公司签订了一份为期六年、价值 100 亿美元的协议。 该交易将与 Bitdeer Technologies Group 合作完成，Bitdeer Technologies Group 是一家在挪威运营数据中心的比特币矿商。

根据协议细节，该托管数据中心预计将采用 Nvidia 的下一代 Vera Rubin AI 芯片。 最近，经过 3 亿美元的融资，Volta 的估值达到 24 亿美元。

Volta 首席执行官 Ricard Boada 拒绝透露该客户的身份。 Anthropic 和 Bitdeer 的代表拒绝置评。

随着企业和消费者越来越多地使用其 Claude 聊天机器人和其他人工智能工具，特别是用于编码和相关任务，该协议增强了 Anthropic 扩大计算能力的努力。

Anthropic 还与 SpaceX、Advanced Micro Devices 和 Akamai Technologies 签订了计算协议，据报道，该公司正在讨论从 Meta Platforms 运营的数据中心租赁计算能力。
